children: Marriott International entered into a Seventh Amended and Restated Credit Agreement to expand and extend its multicurrency revolving credit facility. The agreement increases total commitments to $5.0 billion, with an option to raise commitments to $5.5 billion, and pushes the maturity to September 23, 2031. Borrowings will generally bear interest at SOFR plus a margin tied to Marriott's public debt ratings, with quarterly fees on the same basis, and the facility allows future pricing adjustments based on environmental KPIs. The company expects the facility to enhance liquidity and financial flexibility.
: Multicurrency unsecured revolving credit facility (amended and restated)
: Bank of America, as Administrative Agent, and other lenders
: Increase liquidity, extend maturities, and add flexibility
